identity.name: Bone & Joint Open
identity.publisher: The British Editorial Society of Bone & Joint Surgery
identity.source_note: Main Instructions for Authors page fetched live and clean (not blocked). Reference style, section order, title/abstract structure, and figure DPI came from the journal's own linked 'The structure of a paper' guide PDF (https://s3.eu-west-2.amazonaws.com/baj-live-cms-uploads/The_structure_of_a_paper_2022_2_e0a4a15cd2.pdf), which the live BJO IFA page directly links as its structure guide; its abstract rules match the BJO IFA page exactly.

encoding_notes: BJO IFA page only explicitly invites 'original articles' (mapped to original_research). Study protocols, infographics, and consensus statements are also welcomed but have no clean enum slot.

The linked 'structure of a paper' PDF lists Editorial/Instructional review/Annotation/Specialty update/Clinical/Research article types, but those are explicitly for the sister journal The Bone & Joint Journal (BJJ), NOT BJO, so they were not imported.

manuscript_max_words 4000 is a COMBINED cap: guide states 'maximum of 4000 words including the Abstract, body of the text and References' — so body-only budget is 4000 minus abstract+references. Schema gap (no combined-cap field).
scrub_metadata set true inferred from 'Your main document should be completely blinded' + double-blind review; the guide does not name file metadata explicitly.

Abstract additionally requires 'one or two bullet points which sum up the clinical relevance of the paper' (clinical-relevance highlights within the abstract) — set highlights_required null since it is not a separate Highlights section.

tables.placement null: tables are created with Word's table tool (in-document, not separate files) but the guide does not state inline vs grouped-at-end placement; figure captions/legends are explicitly placed at the end of the paper.
tables.caption_position 'above' inferred from 'each table should have a short, descriptive heading' (a heading denotes top placement); numbering not explicitly stated.

layout font/spacing/margins/page-size/line-numbers/alignment not stated in either source (the only font mention, Arial 8pt, applies to graph labels, not manuscript body); line_numbers set 'none' as the safe not-required default.
references.et_al_threshold and max_count not stated; journal reference example ('Allen GM, Wilson DJ. ... Bone Joint J 2012;95-B:1-50.') uses NLM journal abbreviation and no DOI.
declarations.order is not prescribed by the guide; the listed items are the declarations the guide mentions, arranged conventionally.
RCTs must be prospectively registered (trial_registration) — required only for RCTs, hence in order but not in the universally-required list.
title_page.elements derived from 'all identifying information should be on a separate title page' — the guide does not enumerate an explicit element list.
